professionalSummary: Experienced backend engineer with a focus on push notification services, specializing in provider adapter development, retry scheduling, and staging load testing.
Proficient in drafting runbooks and hand‑over documentation to support SRE operations.
Collaborated closely with mobile app teams and provider account managers to ensure reliable message delivery.
experienceHighlights: Developed provider adapters and retry scheduler for the push notification service in the development environment, with integration tests against provider sandboxes.
Ran load tests against the staging cluster with synthetic traffic up to 15k messages per second, recording latency percentiles and queue depth in the load‑test report for each release candidate.
Authored runbook drafts for the retry scheduler and hand‑over notes for each release candidate, detailing staging‑to‑production differences and open items for SRE.
Contributed to the service over two years, covering adapter development, retry scheduling, staging load tests, runbook drafts and hand‑over notes.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Load‑test report for release candidate twelve with staging cluster run identifiers.
Runbook draft for the retry scheduler.
skills: Collaboration with SRE and mobile teams
